verdicts.reason: None of the San Francisco documents (D078-D083) address application or screening fees. The retrieved fee passages cover Berkeley (D005), California Civil Code 1950.6 (D026, DX08) and Massachusetts (DX13). None of them states that San Francisco lacks a local screening-fee rule, so the documents do not settle the question.

No document says San Francisco lacks tenant screening restrictions. D078 points the other way: it states that San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions. That suggests a screening restriction exists, so no_rule cannot be supported. The documents do not give the rule's scope or text, so it is not settled here.
